_meta.source: Official MLB StatsAPI annual awards/recipients (MLB player IDs)
_meta.career_scope: Awarded at any point through MLB's latest officially posted honors, not necessarily during an attended season.
_meta.mvp_definition: American and National League regular-season MVP awards only
_meta.cy_young_definition: AL/NL and historical combined MLB Cy Young awards only
_meta.gold_glove_definition: Rawlings AL/NL standard Gold Glove awards only
_meta.silver_slugger_definition: AL/NL standard Silver Slugger awards only
_meta.all_star_definition: Official MLB All-Star selections deduplicated by year; not All-MLB Team or All-Star Game appearances

latest_gold_glove_update.method: Supplemental verified award year; source StatAPI import snapshot retained
